headline: COL @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is COL 5.05 at MIN 4.79, with a projected total of 9.85. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: COL moved +0.21 runs while MIN moved -0.52, changing the projected margin by +0.73 runs. The projected total fell -0.31, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Mike Paredes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jake McCarthy, TJ Rumfield, Byron Buxton, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ezequiel Tovar because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
